message.content: The Site Manager, Shuan Carstensen, is lackadaisical and unhelpful, and does not call you when your car is finished being detailed. I dropped off my Infiniti FX35 on Sunday, March 25th, 2012, at 9:30am by appointment. At 3pm—six hours later—I went to pick up my car, even though no one had called to say it was done and ready. To my astonishment, the inside of my car looked like a slick, greasy Vaseline mess!
